name: RCM_MODE_LOOP
meaning: Create default / msg 0x68 arg 1: wraps around the trajectory

name: RCM_MODE_ONEWAY
meaning: msg 0x68 arg 2: stops at the ends

name: RCM_MODE_RETURN
meaning: msg 0x68 arg 4 or 0x1F/0x20: one-way; when not driven it returns home at 400*ratio/100, then sleeps (update NEVER)
